dossier.headline: A busy IPO week: Crystal Crop, Mahanadi Coalfields and Watrana open
dossier.summary: India's primary market had a record July–September quarter, about $9 billion, even as listed stocks fell. The week of 16 November brings three new issues: Crystal Crop Protection's ₹456 crore IPO from November 18, Coal India arm Mahanadi Coalfields from November 19, and SME Watrana Rentals' ₹120.10 crore issue from November 19. No listings are scheduled that week, while Carlsberg India has begun roadshows for an offer of up to $600 million.
why_it_matters: A large IPO calendar competes with listed stocks for the same money
Analysts cited the pipeline's liquidity drain as one reason for the steep fall on October 1
More than 200 companies were in the pipeline at end-September, with Jio and Avaada among the big names
watch: Crystal Crop's anchor book on November 17 and subscription from November 18 to 20
Mahanadi Coalfields' issue from November 19 to 23
questions: Will Carlsberg India file and price its offer before the end of the year?
